creative_direction: Place a small stone retreat on a narrow cliff platform, with a folded roof that resembles two overlapping sheets of deep green metal. The building is original and nonreligious, with one recessed doorway, a slim window, and a terrace facing empty mist. View it from a high three-quarter angle so the roof folds and the layered rock beneath are both visible. Render weathered stone, fine roof seams, and a little moss in sheltered cracks. Use warm gray rock, dark green roofing, and an almost white background. Keep the cliff as a contained sculptural mass with no distant mountains. The quiet shelter should remain the central readable shape at avatar scale.
